dedupe_keys.name: empirical fragility curves data and r code for the 1980 irpinia earthquake effect of ground motion uncertainty

description: This dataset provides the inputs and R code to reproduce empirical seismic fragility curves, with credible intervals, built from damage observed after the 1980 Irpinia earthquake in southern Italy. It was deposited on Mendeley Data by Ioanna Ioannou in 2019 for a research article on how uncertainty in ground-motion intensity affects empirical fragility curves, in five versions. The inputs are a map of the 405 affected municipalities, the damage recorded for the most and least vulnerable building classes aggregated by municipality, the ground-motion intensity levels, and independent prior information on the shape of fragility curves for the two classes; the code fits the simplest and most complex models of the article. Coverage is the area affected by the 1980 event. Access: open download from Mendeley Data. Licence: public domain dedication; free. Caveats: damage is aggregated to municipalities and to two broad building classes. Simulation uses are deriving and testing empirical fragility functions for seismic risk models, and teaching Bayesian fragility fitting. Related records: the collapse volume ratio data and the RIESGOS fragility functions.
